store_data.about_the_game:
Rummy Odyssey: The Roguelite Revolution of Classic Rummy

Rummy Odyssey blends Rummy mechanics with modern Roguelite strategy and the excitement of Deckbuilding.

Defeat the luck factor with your strategy, manipulate your deck, and combine powerful Jokers to multiply your points.

This is not just a game where you arrange tiles and finish; it is a strategic journey where you try to form the best combinations to reach the target score in every round.

                         

                                   

🟢 THE GAME MECHANIC IS VERY SIMPLE

No complex rules. Your goal is to group the tiles in your hand and lay them on the table according to three simple rules:

1. Same Numbers: Tiles with the same number but different colors (e.g., Red 7, Blue 7, Black 7).

2. Sequential Numbers: Consecutive numbers in the same color (e.g., Blue 4, 5, 6).

3. Same Color and Number: Keep identical tiles of the same color and number together (e.g., Red 4, Red 4).

Match tiles, collect points, and advance to the next round. But beware: the target score you need to reach increases with every round!

                   

🔥 BREAK THE RULES WITH JOKERS

Just matching the tiles is not enough; you must empower them.

Turn the rules of the game in your favor with special "Joker Cards" you will collect throughout your adventure.

• Scorers: Multiply your score with cards like "Only Red tiles give 2x points" or "Gain extra points if you use even numbers."

• Game Makers: Gain the right to hold more tiles in your hand or unlock more options in the market.

..

                                

🧪 DRİNKS: FRIENDS FOR TOUGH DAYS

Are things not going well?

Are you left with useless tiles in your hand?

Change your fate by using the single-use Drinks in your inventory.

                  

🛠️ CREATE YOUR OWN LUCK

You don't have to rely on chance. With deckbuilding mechanics, manipulate your deck:

- Keep getting bad tiles? Permanently remove them from your deck.

- Start each run with uniquely themed decks featuring different rule sets, bringing fresh strategies to every game.   

                                

👹 CHALLENGE THE BOSSES

The "Boss" levels waiting for you at the end of each section don't just demand high scores; they restrict you.

• "Curse of Odds": Odd-numbered tiles are worth 0 points.

• "Pattern Breaker": The same set cannot be repeated in each hand.

..

        

💰 RISK OR SECURITY?

Should you spend your earned gold immediately to power up, or save it to generate interest income? Managing your economy is just as crucial as managing your tiles. A rich strategy or a full wallet? The choice is yours.   

In Rummy Odyssey, luck is only the beginning victory depends on your strategy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Party Pong is a 2-4 player online multiplayer beer pong party game with a action card twist. Sink clutch shots, draw ridiculous cards, and turn every round into a full-blown chaotic experience. Whether you’re sweating for the win or shooting for fun, one thing’s guaranteed someone’s getting cooked.

CLASSIC BEER PONG WITH A TWIST

Line up your shots and turn into a pong legend... Every made cup can swing momentum with buffs, curses, distractions, and absolute nonsense. It’s beer pong… but strategy and chaos are always one card away.

ACTION CARDS

Use a growing arsenal of cards to boost your shots, sabotage your opponents, bend the rules, and create highlight-reel moments.
From clean power-ups to “who approved this?” curse cards, every match turns into a new story. 

   

ONLINE CO-OP

Play your way. Party Pong supports 2 to 4 players, Start a match with friends or hop into a quick match either way it’s loud, competitive, friendship threatening energy.

DISRUPT, DISTRACT, DOMINATE

Talk your trash and back it up. Trigger distractions, mess with your opponent’s focus, and create the kind of moments that will make your whole party scream. Winning is great… but winning while being toxic is better.

BEER PONG FEATURES

Redemption

Redemption gives you one last chance to clutch up and fight your way back into the game. If your team is down to the final cup and your opponent sinks it, you have the opportunity to hit a shot of your own to stay in the game.

Bouncing

A single bounce can instantly change the game. Bouncing rewards players with 2 cups!! 

Heating Up / On Fire

Heating Up and On Fire turns streaks. Hitting consecutive shots makes your team enter a powered-up state where you shoot until you miss.

Death Cup

store_data.about_the_game:
Manage your factory, watch numbers grow, and improve it endlessly.

Dumbers is an automation game where you extract numbers, process them with math operations, and deliver to the Hub to progress through infinite levels. Focus on building and refining your factory step by step.

KEY FEATURES

15 UNIQUE BUILDINGS

• 5 Extractor Tiers (T1 to elite T5)

• Mathematical processors that add and multiply the collected items (Adders, Incrementers, Doublers, Triplers, Quadruplers)

• Transport & Logistics (Belts, Express Belts, Mergers, Splitters)

No complex math needed: relax as numbers multiply and flow through your factory.

SYNERGY & STRATEGY SYSTEM

Smart design beats brute force. Processor placement matters:

• Synergy Bonuses: Chain processors strategically for up to +30% bonuses (ADDER → MULTIPLIER, INCREMENTER → ADDER, ADDER CHAINS, MIXED combinations)

• Diminishing Returns: The more processors a resource passes through, the smaller the gain from each one — and longer chains also become slower. Optimize your production lines wisely!

• Dynamic Penalties: Excessive splitters, mergers, and logistics abuse reduce final output at the Hub

• Real-time Feedback: Visual indicators show efficiency and penalties as numbers flow through your factory

Build diverse, efficient layouts instead of spamming the same buildings.

STRATEGIC CHOICES

Resources have dual use: level up to unlock new buildings, or invest in permanent upgrades for production boosts. Every choice enhances your factory's efficiency.

11 UPGRADE PATHS

Boost extraction speed, cut processing time, speed up belts, and more. Unlock bonuses like Lucky Extractor (2x random values) and Processor Efficiency (extra outputs). Each path has 5 progressive levels.

RELAXED GAMEPLAY

• Pause anytime for planning

• Color-coded buildings with efficiency indicators

• Satisfying particle effects and animations

• Idle progression—factory runs while away

• Multiple save slots and auto-save

• Are you tired of placing buildings, or have you reached high levels and the resources you obtain no longer matter? Press Z and admire Zen Mode as you travel through numbers!

INFINITE PROGRESSION

15+ levels with growing targets. Beyond level 15, challenges scale infinitely.

Design efficient layouts. Discover optimal synergy combinations. Master the balance between diversity and optimization in your factory.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Apartment is a first-person psychological horror
where a familiar space begins to live by someone else’s rules.

You wake up in your apartment. At first glance, everything looks the same: the same rooms, the same objects, the same silence. But only at first glance. A strange feeling won’t leave you, as if something has changed.

Suddenly, the silence is shattered by a deafening siren. The countdown has already begun. But what will happen when the time runs out?

In the bedroom, the computer is on. On the screen a code input window.

And then you hear a voice: It demands that you enter the code.

The siren keeps drilling into your ears, making it impossible to concentrate. You don’t understand what is happening or why it’s happening to you.

When the timer reaches zero, the air begins to change. It becomes heavier, denser, and somewhere beyond the walls you hear a quiet, almost imperceptible hiss.

It’s gas.

It slowly fills the apartment.

The apartment is full of details that once seemed insignificant. Hidden compartments, notes, cryptic codes, forgotten objects… All of them are pieces of a puzzle whose meaning you have yet to understand.

Old VHS cameras are watching your every step.

Returning to familiar rooms and discovering new fragments, you begin to see the bigger picture. The apartment holds the answers — but it won’t give them up easily.

Uncover what happened.

And find a way out before it’s too late.

By any means necessary.

Inspired by classic psychological horror and the aesthetics of analog horror and VHS.

A Skill-Driven Top-Down Action Game

You awaken in a fractured dream world with no clear explanation of how you arrived.
Armed with a single weapon, you must move through hostile environments and confront powerful entities blocking your path.

Core Gameplay
Lucid Dream is a top-down action game focused on player control, positioning, and timing.
Progress is earned through observation, adaptation, and consistent execution rather than statistics or automated assistance.

World and Exploration
The dream kingdom is built from rigid structures and distorted logic.
Levels are designed to remain readable under pressure, allowing players to assess threats and react quickly.

Combat Flow
Encounters are fast and demanding.
Success depends on movement, spacing, and timing rather than numerical advantage.

Pressure and Opposition
Enemies apply constant pressure, forcing players to read attack patterns, identify openings, and commit decisively.

Guardians
As you progress, increasingly formidable guardians stand in your way.
These encounters emphasize pattern recognition, composure, and precise execution.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the near future, the standards for human enjoyment are becoming increasingly demanding, and people constantly seek more stimulating content. To meet these heightened expectations, entertainment companies have launched the 'Unit League', a competitive tournament where participants battle each other using various weapons. As a player, you will take charge of managing one of these teams.

 Recruit units needed for your team and deploy them appropriately. Strengthen your team by leveling them up and equipping them, win battles, and achieve good results in the league.

 Basically, combat is played from a third-person perspective, where you choose to 'directly control' one member from your entire team. For league matches, you can select and field 25 team members and support a 'spectator mode' where you watch without any control.

 Each unit type is divided into Mace, Dagger, Greatsword, Greataxe, Dual (Dual Wield), Pistol, Shotgun, Launcher, Rifle, and Sniper, and there is a basic stat difference depending on the type.

 You can earn in-game money (c) and reputation by participating in League Matches, Mini-Games, the Arena, and Bounty Hunts. In-game money can be used to purchase equipment from the shop or recruit players. As your reputation increases, the in-game money you receive from participating in league matches increases, and the rewards you get for clearing mini-games also increase.

 Scientific Capability (f) can be obtained as a final reward at the end of a league season, by disassembling items, or by analyzing street waste. In the Lab, you can use Scientific Capability to raise the level of functions that help with gameplay.

To meet these heightened expectations, entertainment companies have launched the 'Unit League', a competitive tournament where participants battle each other using various weapons. • Multiple endings shaped by the choices you make

What a peaceful day! As the sun sets and the moon begins to shine its light over the village, a young witch finishes her busy day of potion making by hanging her hat and going to bed. But things don't go as planned when the Witch's hat falls on Mona's head and everything comes to life. Now she has to turn everything back to normal!

This "Deluxe" or "DX" version of Mona and the Witch's Hat features a brand new soundtrack, full color graphics, and new animations. It features the same four levels as the original version, and can be completed in about 20 minutes.

Made using GBDK and Zal0's ZGB, a small game engine for making Game Boy homebrew games.

Freyline is a roguelike deckbuilder RPG set in the fantasy realm of Leodin, named after the titular maiden.

Recently a mysterious spell has caused all beings to be consumed with lust, for the chaste order of Leo and Vesper this is something of an annoyance. However Battle Maiden Freyline has been despatched westwards to close the rift and conclude the insane levels of debauchery. 

In Freyline you help our hero by building a deck, navigating branching paths, and survive a series of deadly encounters where victory can be achieved through brutal damage or by overwhelming your enemies through arousal and corruption... which might be easier but Leo and Vesper will likey not look kindly on. Every choice pushes you closer toward one of two destinies and neither path is clean.

Combat is fast, tactical, and deeply replayable (I hope), blending familiar deckbuilding fundamentals with a dual-resource system that rewards risk-taking, restraint, or deliberate imbalance... of find a sick build that breaks the game because it is fun to break things.

Core Gameplay

  • Card-based combat inspired by modern roguelike deckbuilders

  • Two parallel victory conditions:

    • Damage victories through HP reduction

    • Arousal victories that force enemies to.. lose control

  • Enemies telegraph intent, forcing strategic sequencing rather than brute force

  • Every battle is a choice between safety, speed, and temptation

As corruption spreads, It unlocks new cards, events, and routes. with new doors opening other shut. Lean too far in either direction and your run begins to shape itself around your decisions, often irreversibly.

  • Loss of control, possession, and temptation are recurring narrative themes

  • Multiple endings ... well 2... but they will be good I promice

  • A growing card pool supporting multiple playstyles

  • Distinct enemy archetypes with unique weaknesses

  • Events, secrets, and cursed encounters

In the distant past, on an island shrouded in dense mist, four sinners made a pact with the gods to establish the "Kingdom of Silence." **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience.

Help Is On The Way is a sci-fi security simulation where survival depends on what you can’t see directly. You play as Kassandra, a security officer stationed behind a malfunctioning terminal in a remote mining facility. When something goes terribly wrong, your coworker Conor is left navigating the facility’s corridors alone, while you guide him from afar using unreliable security systems.

Conor must finish the remaining work for the day before the escape pod can launch, but an alien presence now stalks the facility. If he dies both your lives are over.

From your terminal, you’ll monitor the facility by shuffling between security cameras, watching for hazards, locked-down areas, and signs of the creature lurking in the dark. You can open, close, and lock doors remotely to control Conor’s path, protect him from danger, or trap threats; if your system allows it.

Your terminal is unstable. Overheating systems will shut down your view, forcing you to cool them manually before you can regain control. On top of that, strict corporate protocols mean you’ll need to sign access papers to authorize certain actions, slowing you down when every second matters.

Balance limited information, failing hardware, and bureaucratic obstacles as you guide Conor through a deadly workday. Help is on the way; but only if you can keep the terminal working long enough!

store_data.about_the_game:
The Developer is a defense game where the protagonist, a developer, successfully activates a control device to defend the planet from alien lifeforms and secure planetary domination.
Turrets pre-installed by the vanguard are scattered across the map and are used to fend off alien waves.
Each wave consists of a unique combination of monsters including melee, tank, ranged, and assassin types. A boss monster appears in the final wave.
When all monsters in a wave are eliminated, the wave ends.

Turrets include Cannon and Missile types, each with 3 levels. The number of bullets or missiles they can fire increases by level.
Since turrets operate within the total power capacity of the control device, the player must manage turning them on and off strategically.
The player also has a weapon, allowing them to lure enemies and defend blind spots of the turrets.
If either the player or the control device runs out of health, the mission fails and the game is over.
If the player successfully survives all waves, the mission is considered a success and they move on to the next planet.

The game is story-driven, allowing players to immerse themselves more deeply by following the storyline.

Overview

You wake up in a gym bathroom stall with no memory. You have nothing but what you're wearing, a gym bag, $20, a protein drink, a mobile phone, and a flyer for a chems dealer. Suddenly you start receiving orders from gym bros for gym supplements. It's time to start the hustle. 

This game will take you on a journey from potty jockey to the ultimate ubermensch Heisen-Bro Hustler.

A light hearted, tongue-in-cheek, self deprecating play on gym bros and culture through the lens of a supps dealer, with an absolute banger of a soundtrack.

Start with $20 in your bank and a chems supplier contact, you receive an order for a supplement from a gym bro.

Buy chems from your supplier to craft supplements ordered by gym bros to make money, raise your rep and gain XP.

With each successful order completed you gain rep and XP. Raise your rep to unlock new chems and the ability to craft new supplement products.

Raise XP to level up to unlock new features such as hiring associate bros who can sell supplements on your behalf.

Miss orders and you lose rep and XP.

Raise your rep with bros and they refer new bro to you.

There are 30 bros to unlock in the game. 

Features

Colorful and vivid gym characters that bring the idiosyncrasies of gym lifestyle and culture alive through gameplay and game character building.

Choose your game difficulty with either Chill, Cardio or Capitano Insano.

Playful and flamboyant, retro 80s style.

Fun mini games that let you unlock achievements.

Absolute banger of a soundtrack with includes over 30 light-hearted songs about gym life and culture.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reborn is a visual novel, written as a psychological horror game. It follows the life of a man who is given a second existence – not as a mercy, but as an experiment carried out by the devil.

You are reborn into a new life with no memory of who you were or why the world feels wrong.
Strange whispers follow you.
Events turn against you.
Opportunities decay without explanation.

As the story unfolds, your choices begin to matter in darker ways. Situations escalate. Tests appear. Lines are crossed, and once crossed, they cannot be undone.

This is not a story about heroism.
It is a story about what happens after justification comes to an end.

A TURNING POINT YOU CANNOT UNDO

Midway through the game, the nature of your existence changes.
What once felt abstract becomes personal.
What once felt optional becomes unavoidable.

PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR — NOT JUMP SCARES

Reborn focuses on slow-burn, atmospheric horror:

  • Unease built through implication, silence, and inevitability

  • Disturbing situations revealed gradually

  • Violence treated as consequence, not spectacle

  • Horror rooted in psychology, not monsters

The most unsettling moments come not from what you see, but from what you understand too late.

CHOICES UNDER PRESSURE

Your decisions influence:

  • How the story unfolds and ends

  • Which characters remain in your life

  • Which paths close permanently

Some choices lead to tests — interactive scenes where success or failure alters the narrative direction.
These are not skill challenges alone. They are reflections of the path you have already chosen.

MULTIPLE ENDINGS 

Reborn features multiple endings shaped by your actions.
Some are louder.
Some are quieter.
None erases the past.

Even attempts at repentance carry consequences.

FEATURES

  • Deep, branching narrative with irreversible outcomes

  • Psychological test scenes are integrated into the story

  • Slow-burn horror with an oppressive atmosphere

  • Minimal UI to maintain immersion

  • Designed for replayability without repetition

  • A story that continues after damnation

CONTENT WARNING

This game contains mature themes, including psychological distress, violence, moral coercion, death, and emotional manipulation. It is intended for an adult audience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the brand-new world of "Dynasty Rush"!

With the permission and support of Ironhide Game Studio (the developer of the "Kingdom Rush" series)regarding the gameplay and art style, , a new independent tower defense game, "Dynasty Rush", has officially sounded the drums of war and embarked on the journey. This is not just a game, but a summons across time and space, inviting you to personally wield military power, devise strategies, and write your own Chinese-style journey.

You will lead a legendary army that transcends time and space, traversing magnificent landscapes. From the misty water towns of the south of the Yangtze River to the ancient Silk Road of Loulan with its vast sandstorms, every stage is a vivid picture scroll that condenses Chinese geography and culture. Your mission is grand and arduous: to resist the omnipresent and malevolent Eastern pirates, to quell the internal rebels who vent their violence, and reclaim the lost territories of the Western Regions that have been degraded due to heresy. On this path filled with flames of war, you are not only conquering battlefields, but also exploring the time-honored governance principles of "peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation" through "bloody" practices, and witnessing the inclusive and ever-growing power of Chinese civilization.

We deeply understand the strategic essence of tower defense games and infuse them with a unique Chinese soul.

10 elite troops at your disposal: Each stage features 10 unique advanced towers, forming an unbreakable battle line for you.

Among them is the "Supreme Master" who follows the natural Tao: summoning heavenly thunder and earthly fire, applying talismans and array formations, and purifying evil with the power of heaven and earth.

The ultimate "Firearm Arsenal" of craftsmen: combining ancient black technology, from swarm rockets to sky-shaking mines, covering the battlefield with overwhelming firepower.

The "Imperial Corps", united as iron: forming a formidable steel phalanx, they will not concede an inch of ground, using their flesh and blood to build the most reliable fortress.

Heroes emerge in abundance, heed your call: heroes and warriors from history and legend will come forth at your behest, ready to follow your command. Leading the charge is General Guan, known for his unwavering loyalty and Green Dragon crescent moon blade. Wherever his blade strikes, victory awaits. And this is merely the beginning of the dazzling constellation of heroes.

Deep mechanisms, endless strategies: inheriting the classics and pioneering the future. In the future, we will introduce a dynamic "right time and place" system - the battlefield weather and time changes will directly affect the battle situation; as well as a deep "military strategy" growth tree and clever strategies, allowing every choice you make to incorporate the wisdom of Sun Tzu's Art of War and the philosophy of Chinese civilization.

The game combines a distinctive classic style with traditional elements, making each scene resemble a classical scroll that can be traveled and inhabited. The bgm is masterfully composed, with war drums, flutes, and guzheng interweaving to create a magnificent epic of the expedition. There are also rich historical illustrations and cultural allusions embedded within, allowing you to savor the profoundness of Chinese culture amidst the battles.

"Dynasty Rush" is not just a game; it embodies a romantic vision of Chinese civilization and represents a harmonious fusion of strategy and culture. The vast landscape serves as the board, with heroes and warriors as the pieces. This epic tower defense game, transcending time and space, awaits every strategist to deploy troops with precision and make decisive moves.

The beacon has been lit, and the journey has begun. This land of mountains and rivers welcomes your arrival, my lord!

Waste of Space

The universe didn’t fall apart in a war.
It fell apart in a meeting.

Waste of Space is a space-based card-collector and deck-builder set in a future where interplanetary governance has collapsed into bureaucracy, opportunism, and quiet rebellion. You assemble crews, ships, and equipment from a growing pool of catastrophically unqualified assets, deploy them on missions across the Solar System and beyond, and decide which broken vision of the future survives.

Earth’s ruling authority, the Strategic Mandate for Earth Governance, is failing from the top down. Mars controls the life support. The outer systems are fortifying, hoarding, and drifting away. Beyond Neptune, something new is forming; post-human, patient, and unconcerned with Earth’s relevance.

Every encounter is a battle of attributes, ego, and bad decisions. Cards clash, systems fail, incidents escalate, and nothing ever goes entirely to plan. Victory is measured in acceptable losses. Failure is meticulously logged.

Your choices shape the political endgame:

  • Dismantle Earth’s mandate and break the system entirely

  • Suppress the outer continuity before humanity becomes obsolete

  • Or navigate a fragile coexistence, balancing control, adaptation, and survival

The further you travel, the stranger the universe becomes and the less it cares about where you came from.

Key Features

  • Card collecting and deck-building focused on crews, ships, and equipment

  • Attribute-driven confrontations inspired by classic card face-offs

  • A branching political narrative shaped by faction diplomacy

  • A bleakly comic sci-fi universe where paperwork outlasts civilisation

The universe is vast. Your crew is terrible.

Proceed anyway.

store_data.about_the_game:
After death, you are a soul condemned to drift. Venture into the Great Beyond, traverse an eerie archipelago, and discover the mystery behind your punishment.

Will you find eternal rest, or succumb to the fog?

Stealth is your tool, escape is your salvation

Move through the shadows with cunning and tactics. If discovered, the calm shatters, giving way to a frantic pursuit. Run, improvise, and fight in a desperate escape.

Traverse a shifting archipelago

Every time you set sail, the geography transforms. You must adapt to new routes, unforeseen dangers, and unknown terrains with every attempt. The path to the afterlife is rewritten with every tide.

Face the extraordinary

You will encounter creatures that, though powerful and extraordinary, inhabit the physical and tangible dimension, roaming as naturally as wild animals. Face them with fear and daring.

Mysticism and roots

Immerse yourself in a narrative inspired by the folklore and worldview of Chiloé. An atmosphere that transports you to the heart of the archipelago, featuring an original soundtrack by Grupo Chilhué.

  • Organic Stealth: Seamlessly transition from silent planning to reactive action. Being seen is not a restart, but the beginning of a tense pursuit.

  • Procedural Navigation: A procedural generation system ensures that every island and every route is a unique challenge. You will never cross the same sea twice.

  • Mythic Reality: Discover a story inspired by the Chilotan mythos: mythical beings that are not mere symbols, but the very fabric of reality.

  • The Mystery of the Punishment: Reveal the fragments of your past life, understand the origin of the fog, and find a way to break the chains that bind you to the archipelago.

  • Roguelite Progress: Death is only the beginning; face a different challenge every time and learn from your mistakes in every cycle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build. Automate. Dominate the Chip Market.

The year is 2047. A decade after the Great Chip Drought collapsed the semiconductor industry, mega-corporations lie in ruins. From the ashes, a new breed of manufacturer has emerged:

the μFabbers — small, agile micro-fabricatorswielding cutting-edge nano-manufacturing technology.

You are one of them.

Build your chip fabrication empire from the ground up. Design intricate production lines, unlock advanced technologies, and scale from simple processors to legendary quantum chips worth fortunes. But beware — Helena Voss and her Voss Dynamics mega-corp are watching, waiting to crush any μFab that threatens their monopoly.

Features

Deep Factory Automation

  • Design sprawling production lines across 3 factory floors — plus secret dimensions

  • Route materials with conveyor belts, splitters, sorters, lifts, and throwing belts

  • Manage defect rates, optimize throughput, and exploit the black market

  • Watch your factory come alive with satisfying visual feedback

Complex Chip Manufacturing

  • Process silicon wafers through multiple stages: etching, chemical treatment, ion implantation, and EUV lithography

  • Create 13 chip tiers — from basic X1000 processors to legendary DC4000 Dual Cores.

  • Master L4 production paths: dice wafers into mini chips for quantity, or fuse cores for maximum value

  • Manage the delicate balance between speed and quality — too many defects and your wafers shatter

Alternate Dimensions

  • Unlock the Pocket Dimension: 50% faster processing at double the power cost — but beware the void decay

  • Discover the Temporal Rift: slower time means fewer defects, with rotating platforms offering 95% defect reduction

  • Route items through dimensional portals for advanced production strategies

Strategic Progression

  • Research 50+ technologies across 7 branches: Logistics, Automation, Control, Manufacturing, Power, Quality, and Black markets

  • Unlock powerful machines like the floor-spanning Lithography Machine, Laser Reflector arrays, and the Dual Core Combiner

  • Navigate dynamic market prices with saturation mechanics — flood the market and watch prices crash

  • Choose exclusive research paths: Wafer Dicing OR Dual Core Combining — specialize your factor

Prestige System

  • Reset your factory to unlock permanent upgrades that persist forever

  • Earn prestige points based on your lifetime chip sales

  • Unlock dimension access, bulk discounts, defect reduction, and factory blueprints

  • Each run gets stronger — how far can you push your empire?

Automation Mastery

  • Deploy Controllers, Counters, and Terminals to create smart factory logic

  • Write custom automation scripts with the Terminal machine's built-in programming language

  • Set up threshold triggers, logic gates, and event-driven automation

Build self-sustaining production lines that run while you plan your next expansion

NAND Challenges & Mini-Games

  • Machines jam! Pay a hefty fee or solve logic puzzles to get back online

  • Master NAND gate challenges that scale in difficulty

  • Push your luck with overclocking — faster machines that risk more jams

  • Discover secret codes for bonus rewards and easter eggs

  • Play Snake on Dr. Chen's virtual PC when you need a break

Polished Presentation

  • Watch items transform visually as they're processed — more layers mean more intricate patterns

  • High-tier chips shimmer with holographic effects and rainbow sparkles

  • Customize your factory with unlockable machine skins

  • Three graphics quality settings with advanced fluid dynamics on high

  • Atmospheric factory ambiance with dust motes and machine sparks

Characters & Story

  • Meet Dr. Maya Chen, your brilliant (and coffee-fueled) research scientist

  • Trade with Rico "Junkyard" Martinez for bulk material discounts

  • Face off against Helena Voss, the ruthless CEO determined to rebuild her monopoly

  • Uncover the story through milestone events and rival confrontations

Three Difficulty Modes

  • Easy: Learn the ropes with reduced defects and cheaper rent

  • Medium: The intended challenge

  • Hard: Punishing margins for factory optimization veterans

The Factory Awaits — Again and Again and Again

Start with a single etcher and a dream. End with a multi-dimensional automated megafactory churning out dual-core

quantum processors. Every belt placed, every research unlocked, every chip sold brings you one step closer to

dominance.

Prestige your factory. Unlock new dimensions. Master the market.

The semiconductor revolution won't wait. Will you rise to meet it?

MicroFab is fully playable in English, Spanish (Español), Portuguese (Português), French (Français), German (Deutsch), and Hindi (हिन्दी) — including complete UI, tutorials, and all in-game text. I want every player to experience the game in their language. I will add more translations on request!

GRUNGE is a single-player, atmospheric FPS set in a decaying post-apocalyptic world. It combines methodical pacing with highly lethal combat. There are no bullet sponges here. Combat is fast, deadly, and relies on positioning rather than stats.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Lethal "Glass Cannon" Combat: You are not a tank. Enemies die in 1-2 shots, but so do you.

  • The Repeater Mechanic (Quick-Save): You are equipped with a "Repeater" unit that allows for instant manual quick-saving. Death is frequent, but reloading is instant. Quick-save as often as you reload.

  • Equipment-Based Progression: You get better gear as you progress, and combat effectiveness is primarily driven by what you're carrying.

  • No Survival Chores: Focus purely on exploration and combat. There are no hunger, thirst, or stamina meters to manage.

CONTENT & REPLAYABILITY

  • The World: Explore dense, hostile, and interconnected levels filled with environmental storytelling, hidden secrets, and blocked paths.

  • Atmosphere: Powered by a custom rendering pipeline in Unreal Engine 5, designed for retro-styled visuals, high performance, and a responsive "old-school" game feel.

  • The Playtime: Roughly 8-hour experience.

NO CLEAN START is a single-player psychological survival experience built around repetition, failure, and learning.

You are not meant to win on your first attempt.
You are meant to observe, adapt, and try again — changed.

The world reacts to what you do.
It remembers your actions, your mistakes, and your patterns.

Each run reshapes the experience, not through numbers or upgrades, but through understanding.

Design Philosophy

NO CLEAN START avoids traditional hand-holding.
There is no excessive HUD, no explicit guidance, and no power fantasy.

Information is earned through attention, not tutorials.
Failure is expected — and often necessary.

Structure

The game is built around repeated attempts.

Death is not a restart.
It is a continuation — carrying knowledge, consequences, and subtle changes forward.

Development Status

NO CLEAN START is currently in active development.

A playable demo is planned for February.
Development is being shared openly, with frequent updates and transparent design decisions.

store_data.about_the_game:
While exploring the walls of an ancient pyramid, when it seemed the place held nothing more than the dust of bygone eras, tragedy strikes. Weakened by time and oblivion, the stone floor of the courtyard collapses, and your companion vanishes deep beneath the earth. Determined to save them, you descend into the pyramid — unaware that you have just awakened something that should never have been disturbed.

Depengate draws you into a world of puzzles, secrets, and rising tension, where every step may have consequences. Players are separated by space, perspective, and information — you see different things, have access to different mechanisms, and hear different sounds. Only through close cooperation and precise communication can you move forward.

What is Depengate?

  • A cooperative game for two players: solving puzzles requires two people, and each player has a role to play.

  • Mysterious locations: explore the corridors and labyrinths of an ancient pyramid.

  • A multitude of puzzles: talk to each other and share what you see and hear to escape this thrilling digital escape room.

Will you and your partner manage to survive in a world where every symbol may be a clue and every decision the beginning of a catastrophe? Or will your attempt at cooperation be the spark that leads to irreversible events?

WARNING: The game is strictly cooperative. An internet connection and voice communication between players are required — either directly or via a voice chat application.

Tidal Break is a single-player discovery puzzle roguelite where you uncover the forgotten history of a mysterious island by combining elemental fish to create new elements.

The island was never meant to be found again.

They shimmer with elemental energy. Fire. Water. Air. Earth. They shouldn't exist. But when you combine them, something happens. Something the island remembers.

The tide is rising...

Catch, combine, and experiment with fish imbued with elemental properties. Each successful combination unlocks new fish and reveals fragments of the island's past. Piece together what happened as you work toward the truth.

Features

  • Unique fish to discover through elemental combinations

  • Roguelite progression that persists between runs

  • Environmental storytelling that unfolds as you experiment

  • Single-player experience

Inspired by the satisfying discovery loops of combination games like Doodle God and Little Alchemy, reimagined with narrative depth and 3D presentation.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shipping & Handling is a cooperative multiplayer sandbox delivery game about moving through hostile environments while keeping a shared payload from damage until delivered!

You and your crew take on delivery runs across strange, dangerous spaces, dealing with terrain hazards, limited resources, and the chaos that comes from coordinating as a team. Stay alive and keep the delivery intact.

Core Gameplay

Players form a delivery crew and are tasked with delivering lost packages and transporting them to extraction points across large, hostile environments.

  • Scout routes and terrain

  • Collect cargo with varying sizes and weights

  • Transport cargo using silly tools, mounts, and physics-based interactions

  • Deal with hazards, enemies, and obstacles in clever and unique ways

  • Deliver successfully to earn rewards and unlock progression

  • Recover from failure when cargo is dropped, damaged, or lost

Each delivery can be completed multiple ways, but poor coordination or risky shortcuts can result in lost cargo and failed runs.

Online Multiplayer Co-op

  • Online cooperative multiplayer

  • Players coordinate movement, timing, and tool usage

  • Mistakes affect the entire team and create cascading problems

  • Solo play is possible, but the game is designed around emergent multiplayer situations

Traversal & Physics Systems

  • Physics-based balancing system

  • Vertical traversal including climbing, jumping, and sliding

  • Dynamic hazards such as unstable ground, environmental obstacles, hostile wildlife, and enemy robots attempting to steal deliveries

  • Cargo physically interacts with the world and players

Movement is intentionally physical and imperfect, creating unpredictable and often hilarious outcomes

Tools, Gear, and Mounts

  • Equip specialized tools to move cargo and navigate terrain

  • Deploy gadgets to create new paths and support your crew, including:

    • Ladders

    • Bridges

    • Grappling hooks

    • Healing hot tubs

    • Energy Drink Grenades 

    • And more!

  • Use mounts to assist with transport; mounts must be fed and cared for, and may need to be abandoned if situations worsen

Progression & Rewards

  • Earn currency from successful deliveries

  • Unlock new tools, upgrades, and traversal options

  • Access more dangerous delivery zones with higher rewards

  • Unlock Cosmetics

World & Tone

  • Stylized, low-poly, cartoony world

  • Multiple large delivery zones

  • A growing set of tools, cargo types, traversal challenges, and player customization

What Makes Shipping & Handling Unique

Shipping & Handling focuses on the act of co-op navigation through complex environments and active combat zones while keeping the payload safe from damage or theft.

The challenge comes from coordination, physical interaction, and route choice, creating unpredictable and memorable situations!

Shipping & Handling is being developed by a small independent team with experience working on large-scale multiplayer games, including developers who previously worked on Rec Room.

The game is currently in active development. Features, content, and scope may change as development continues.

Command massive planetary fleets in Star Command! An immersive real-time strategy epic. Utilize advanced physics engines to outsmart commanders worldwide in deep-space battlefronts. Conquer systems, upgrade fortresses, and turn the tide with "Shield Bursts." Featuring 1v1 Duels, 2v2Team Battle and 6-player Global Chaos.

2. About This Game

[Restoring Order to the Galaxy] The galaxy has slumbered in the "Great Silence" for three hundred years. As the last awakened Executor, you will carry the "Genesis Key" across eight lost sectors. This is not merely a journey of conquest, but a tactical game concerning the renaissance of civilization.

[Core Gameplay: Macro Tactics & Physical Micro-management]

  • Galactic Conquest: Every planet is your arsenal. Rationally allocate population growth and fleet deployment to build a solid logistics network.

  • Fleet Merging System: Units automatically cluster into powerful battle groups during hyperspace jumps, reducing chaos while greatly enhancing the visual impact of large-scale skirmishes.

  • Shield Burst: Once the planetary shield is fully charged, you can unleash a devastating energy pulse, evaporating all enemies entering the orbital ring.

  • Stellar Cataclysm: Capturing the central "Stellar Core" triggers a supernova. This is a "strategic nuke" capable of instantly wiping out all mobile units on the map—a gambit of high risk and high reward.

3. The Multiplayer Experience

The soul of this game lies in its minimalist multiplayer system.

Diverse Combat Modes:

  • Ranked Duel (1v1): Climb the MMR ladder in a pure contest of intellect and reflexes, aiming for the "God of War" rank.

  • Dark Forest Brawl (6-Player FFA): A survival game filled with chains of suspicion. You can choose to lie low and grow, or scavenge for profit while your opponents destroy each other.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Team Principal: A Racing Manager. Initially a passion project, this game has become much more for me. It is a completely customizable grand prix/motorsport manager game, with a simplistic top down 2d race view. Most of the game is in the in-depth management aspect. Some key features include:

- An ever-changing grid: Teams & engines can leave, go bankrupt, join, rebrand, get bought out, fluctuate season to season. No two seasons will ever be the same, with a virtually limitless grid size.
- Simplistic, yet in-depth race simulation complete with customizable temperature, weather, dirty air, tire wear, fuel consumption, safety cars, mechanical wear, and realistic results, with both simulated and non-simulated options available.

- In-Depth finance system with stock, ownership, and ability to purchase stakes in rivals.

- Completely in-depth academy pipe-line system with ability to pay to assign your rookie drivers in junior series teams, have them test for you, learn the ropes in rival junior teams you own, and eventually promote them to your team.

- In-depth regulatory system that can change the environment of the game season to season.

- In-depth negotiation system for tyres, parts, sponsorship, works engines, customer engines, and drivers. 

- Ability to build and sell your own engines through an engine plant, or partner with an existing engine supplier.

- Extremely intelligent AI who are truly difficult to beat.

- Fully fleshed out car attributes, driver attributes, staff attributes, headquarters, etc.

- In-depth chassis, aero, engine, and tyre development.

This game aims to be a simplistic, yet fully customizable racing management sandbox experience for racing in every era, with almost every aspect of the game able to be edited and changed. Team names, performance, dirty air, tire model, points model, anything one can think of can be edited to your liking.

This game is in active development & will receive extremely frequently updates. Please join the game's discord server, wherein I will share future plans, update timelines, provide bug support, as well as the track editor. This game is extremely mod friendly, and an open canvas for any situations one wishes to develop.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build, expand, and destroy. In this card strategy game, you're not just surviving — you're fighting a war. Collect poker combinations to develop the settlement, manage individual decks of Outposts to contain the threat, and use powerful artifacts. Your goal is to completely clear the map of monsters.

BUILD AN IMPREGNABLE FORTRESS

Forget about the boring shuffling of cards. Your settlement is a complex mechanism. To build a forge, a wall or a tower of magicians, you need to collect the perfect combination of cards in your hand. Plan your moves, discard the excess and look for synergies that will turn your village into an economic war machine.

MANAGE MULTI-DECKS

The main feature of the game is Outposts. These are not just buildings, but your strategic outposts on the edge of darkness.

Separate Decks: Each Outpost has its own mini-deck and mechanics.

Threat Deterrence: The more effective your outposts are, the lower the chance of a surprise monster attack on the capital.

Expansion: Competent management of several decks at the same time is the key to victory.

ADAPT OR DIE.

The world is cruel. You will face Disasters: droughts, epidemics and magical storms will test your defenses. But what doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Find and use Permanent Cards (Artifacts) — global bonuses that stay with you and change the rules of the game, allowing you to create unique builds for each party.

THE GOAL: TOTAL EXTERMINATION

In most games, you hide from monsters. Here you go for them. Your task is not to last N days, but to destroy the entire population of monsters.

Build up your military power, send troops on raids and clear the map sector by sector. But remember: if the monsters break through the Outpost line, your capital will fall.
